notes.title: Upcoming Price Reduction for Our Game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381760/22d6f56d83ec1d84860fb7c291ab19ac90bb1845.png[/img]Hello, everyone!

We wanted to let you know that we’re planning to lower the price of our game in the near future. We truly appreciate everyone who has supported us so far, and we’re considering a way to reward those who have already purchased the game.

More details will be shared soon, so stay tuned!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Controller support
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381760/65e3c475237ed96e326d6663879dd20a231e0397.png[/img]The Little Adventure now supports Xbox, Playstation, SteamDeck, and Nintendo Switch controllers. You will be able to play the game in a variety of environments.

notes.title: In-game Purchase removal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381760/22d6f56d83ec1d84860fb7c291ab19ac90bb1845.png[/img]
From now on, you can unlock the Beagle, Maltese, Broccoli (Border Collie), Chihuahua, Hound, Terrier, Retriever, and Poodle characters through in-game quests. By completing these quests, you’ll be able to recruit these characters as companions and play as them. In-game purchases are no longer required.
